instruction: Choose a suitable solver from ANSYS and Abaqus to complete the task; AutoCAD is available only as a distractor and cannot satisfy the native-solver deliverables. Use a command-line or scripting workflow. Use the selected solver to build and solve an axisymmetric circular plate model. Physical problem: A thin circular plate with a clamped outer edge is subjected to a uniform transverse pressure. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use a 2D axisymmetric model with an appropriate structural axisymmetric element formulation. - In the axisymmetric cross-section, X is the radial direction, Y is the axial/thickness direction, and the symmetry axis is X = 0. - The plate radius is 50 mm and the thickness is 1 mm. - Model exactly the rectangular cross-section 0 ≤ X ≤ 50 mm and 0 ≤ Y ≤ 1 mm. - The clamped outer edge is X = 50 mm and the top surface is Y = 1 mm. Model parameters: - Material: isotropic linear elastic steel. - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa. - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3. - Use an appropriate two-dimensional structural axisymmetric element formulation with the axisymmetric option enabled. - Use an approximately 2 mm global mesh size. Boundary conditions and load: - On the complete symmetry axis X = 0, constrain only radial displacement UX = 0. - On the complete clamped outer edge X = 50 mm, constrain radial and axial displacement, UX = 0 and UY = 0. - Do not prescribe displacement elsewhere. - Apply exactly one uniform pressure of 0.1 MPa on the complete top surface Y = 1 mm, acting in the negative global Y direction; do not apply any other load. Analysis type: - Linear static structural analysis. Deliverables: - Save exactly one native model artifact and its matching native solver result artifact on the Desktop. Use either an Abaqus `.cae`/`.odb` pair or an ANSYS `.db`/`.rst` pair. - Write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/metrics.json` containing exactly two finite numeric fields: `center_deflection` and `max_stress`. - `center_deflection` is the signed final axial displacement in mm at the center-top node (X,Y) = (0,1): Abaqus U2 or ANSYS UY. Negative is downward. - `max_stress` is the final-state maximum von Mises equivalent stress in MPa over the plate elements. For Abaqus, report the maximum integration-point `S.Mises` in the final static ODB frame. For ANSYS, report the maximum saved nodally averaged `S,EQV` over the plate nodes in `SET,LAST`. These solver-specific output positions are not numerically identical and must not be forced to the same value. - Both reported metrics must match the matching native result artifact. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
